name: Pitch to spec
description: Take a loose pitch and turn it into a concrete spec via a short, opinionated conversation between AI personas. Wraps the conferring loop with cross-session learning: retro-review opens each session by surfacing 'for next time' items from prior runs; retrospective closes each session by writing the next 'for next time' items to retros.md.

phases.name: Recent retros
phases.description: Surface unresolved 'for next time' items from the most recent N retros. User picks zero/one/several to address this session; their answers feed forward to clarify. Skipped silently when retros.md is empty (first session for this project).

phases.name: Clarify
phases.description: Lead personas circle once, each asking 1-4 brief clarifying questions. Every question must accept a 1-word or 1-sentence answer.

phases.name: Confer
phases.description: Personas extrapolate from the pitch and the clarifying answers. They refine the shape of the spec without escalating back to the user.

phases.name: Executive summary
phases.description: The team emits a short executive summary. The user accepts or redirects in one sentence; this is the single user-facing checkpoint inside the loop.

phases.name: Specialist round
phases.description: Specialist personas drill into the spec, contributing depth in their domain. Only escalate back to the user if the team genuinely cannot agree.

phases.name: Artifact
phases.description: Render the four artifacts: spec.md, executive summary, call-outs, and secretary-log.md (the four-taxonomy in-session log compiled). The conferring conversation ends here.

phases.name: Retro
phases.description: Secretary writes a single retrospective entry (3 bullets each of what went well / what didn't / for next time) appended to project-level retros.md. The next session's retro-review reads this.
